reason: Bricks and metal stock seem like a useful starting structure for a place to sit or work.
expectation: I expect to make some kind of sturdy support or furniture frame, though its exact form is unclear.

alternatives.reason: Felt and fabric could make a cushion, but I want to build the supporting structure first.

effect: The bricks and metal made a bench with both a seat and a worktop, so the remaining materials may make it more comfortable.
reaction: I like that the same materials used for the workshop now make a place by the window.
reason: Felt and fabric are the only available combination, and they seem suited to padding the bare bench.
expectation: I expect to make a cushion or other soft covering, though I don't know exactly how it will be used.

effect: The felt and fabric made a cushion that can now be fitted to the bench.
reaction: The springy cushion is a satisfying detail for the cabin’s first soft seat.
reason: The cushion and bench are the only available combination, and fitting them together should finish the sitting area.
expectation: I expect a cushioned window bench, possibly completing the goal.

effect: The cushion completed the window bench and the chapter’s goal, giving the cabin a place to sit and work.
reaction: The image of watching the sunset from the padded seat feels like a satisfying payoff.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the bare bench was most worthwhile: the bricks and metal became both a seat and a worktop, connecting this quiet space to the earlier workshop materials.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cushion was pleasant but predictable; once the bench existed, the remaining materials suggested padding.

surprise.text: I was a little surprised that the bench included a worktop as well as a seat.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary. The materials had clear purposes, though the final two combinations were the only available actions.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because the sunset detail makes me curious about daily life on Mars and what happens over the remaining months.
